Garsoniere moderne 34.5 m²
Rruga Ali Demi 100 m mbi shkollen Kushtrimi Lirise Tiranë.
Kati 2 teresisht i rinovuar ne nje pallat egzistues.
E mobiluar plotësisht me stil bashkëkohor: Ambient open-space me ajer te kondicionuar,WiFi , kuzhinë moderne me pajisje të gjitha të reja.
Tualet me dritare per ajerosje natyrale tharse, hekur hekurosje, fshese me korent dhe gjithcka te nevojshme e,funksionale te pershtatshme direkt per banim, investim Airbnb ose qera afatgjate. 
Me hipoteke .
Cmimi 86 000 euro per bleres cash jo me kredi.
Per momentin garsoniere eshte e dhene me qera mujore 400 euro
title_en: Studio for sale in Ali Demi
description_en: Modern studio 34.5 m² Ali Demi Street 100 m above Kushtrimi Lirise school Tirana. 2nd floor completely renovated in an existing building. Fully furnished in a contemporary style: open-space environment with air conditioning, WiFi, modern kitchen with all new appliances. Toilets with windows for natural drying ventilation, ironing iron, vacuum cleaner and everything necessary and functional, suitable directly for housing, Airbnb investment or long-term rent. With mortgage. The price is 86,000 euros for cash buyers, not with credit. At the moment, the studio is rented for 400 euros per month
